note: Crafting recipes of 1.8.9 (CraftingManager and the Recipes* helpers), written from memory in LegacyCraft item names. 'key' letters and shapeless ingredients name an item, or '#group' for any item of a group (vanilla's wildcard metadata). Shaped recipes may be placed anywhere in the grid and also match mirrored left to right. Special recipes (tool repair) are built in; armour dyeing, fireworks, banners, map and book copying are not yet (DEV-024).
